method.warm: CUDA graph batches of ~1.5 ms, each after a 50 us GPU spin (start event recorded on a busy GPU)
method.cold: single launches, each after a read sweep of 3x L2
method.span_us: mean over trace_reps launches of last warp exit - first warp entry (globaltimer); CSV column span_us_median holds this mean
method.warmup: 0.3 s before the first case, >= 20 ms per case, >= 20 ms of graph launches per warm case
